### 1 — Scene
A rice-and-beef meal with shredded green salad, plus a separate bowl of mixed cooked vegetables. The glass appears to contain water, so it contributes no energy.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 25 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ **491 cm²**.
- **Vegetable bowl:** approximately 21 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10.5² ≈ **346 cm²**.

### 3 — Visible items
White rice, cooked beef strips with a few onion pieces, shredded leafy salad, sweetcorn, carrots, and broccoli. No separate dressing or oil quantity is clearly distinguishable; the beef energy estimate allows for its cooked preparation.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares are assigned without double-counting overlapping foods; rice beneath the beef makes its depth particularly uncertain.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 28% of plate | 137 × 1.5 = 206 ml | 0.8 | 165 g | 130 | 215 kcal |
| Beef with onion pieces | 32% of plate | 157 × 1.0 = 157 ml | 0.95 | 149 g | 230 | 343 kcal |
| Shredded green salad | 22% of plate | 108 × 2.0 = 216 ml | 0.15 | 32 g | 20 | 6 kcal |
| Sweetcorn | 18% of bowl | 62 × 1.6 = 100 ml | 0.6 | 60 g | 90 | 54 kcal |
| Carrots | 17% of bowl | 59 × 1.6 = 94 ml | 0.6 | 56 g | 35 | 20 kcal |
| Broccoli | 20% of bowl | 69 × 1.6 = 111 ml | 0.6 | 66 g | 35 | 23 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **82% of the main plate** and **55% of the bowl’s projected area** contain food.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate totals **528 g and approximately 660 kcal**. This is plausible for the visible rice-and-meat plate and modest vegetable side. The largest uncertainties are the rice hidden beneath the beef and the beef’s fat content.
